description.title: כללי בחינת זכאות מחדש
description.summary: This table outlines the rules for re-examining eligibility for long-term care benefits, specifically for claims exceeding 3 months. It details the process Harel uses to reassess an insured's medical and functional condition.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את הכללים לבחינת זכאות מחדש לתקופת תשלום מאושרת העולה על שלושה חודשים, עבור ביטוח סיעודי של Harel. הבחינה מחדש כוללת התחשבות במצב הרפואי והתפקודי של המבוטח, גילו, המידע שנמסר לחברה ותנאי הפוליסה. המבוטח עשוי להידרש להמציא מסמכים רפואיים עדכניים או לעבור בדיקה על ידי אנשי מקצוע מטעמה של Harel. אי שיתוף פעולה או אי המצאת מסמכים בזמן עלולים להוביל להפסקת תשלום גמלאות או לעיכוב בתשלומן. כללי בחינת זכאות מחדש, גיל המבוטח, מסמכים רפואיים, בדיקה על ידי אנשי מקצוע, Harel.
notable_values: re-examination trigger: end of approved period
factors considered: medical condition, age, policy conditions
examination method: medical documents, professional examination

sketch:
oules for re-examination of eligibility
1. A claim for an approved period - for a period exceeding 3 months
Approval of a periodic claim for additional defined periods beyond the approved period, shall require - at the end of the period approved for payment - re-examination of the insured's medical and functional condition.
Upon re-examination of the liability and its performance, the insured's medical condition, age, the information provided to the company and the policy conditions shall be taken into account, inter alia.
The re-eligibility examination may be performed, inter alia, in accordance with the insured's condition and age by way of inspection of current medical documents regarding the insured's medical or functional condition, or by having the insured examined by appropriate professionals on behalf of Harel.
Towards the end of the eligibility period, Harel shall approach you for the purpose of conducting the re-eligibility examination. As part of this approach, you may be required to submit to Harel current medical documents or to schedule an examination to assess your current functional and medical condition, in the framework of the times noted in the request.
Failure to provide the requested documents timeously and/or non-cooperation regarding an examination by an appropriate professional determined by Harel in a timely manner may result in termination of payment of insurance benefits or delay in payment thereof.
Harel reserves the right to conduct a re-examination of your eligibility if necessary, even in cases where the insured's eligibility is confirmed for a predetermined period and during the period information is received by Harel which differs from that provided by the insured and/or which was known to Harel and indicates that the insured may have ceased to be eligible for insurance benefits.

טבלה: כללי בחינת זכאות מחדש
This table outlines the rules for re-examining eligibility for long-term care benefits, specifically for claims exceeding 3 months. It details the process Harel uses to reassess an insured's medical and functional condition.
ממדים: rules for re-examination of eligibility, criteria and procedures for re-examination

oules for re-examination of eligibility
1. A claim for an approved period - for a period exceeding 3 months
Approval of a periodic claim for additional defined periods beyond the approved period, shall require - at the end of the period approved for payment - re-examination of the insured's medical and functional condition.
Upon re-examination of the liability and its performance, the insured's medical condition, age, the information provided to the company and the policy conditions shall be taken into account, inter alia.
The re-eligibility examination may be performed, inter alia, in accordance with the insured's condition and age by way of inspection of current medical documents regarding the insured's medical or functional condition, or by having the insured examined by appropriate professionals on behalf of Harel.
Towards the end of the eligibility period, Harel shall approach you for the purpose of conducting the re-eligibility examination. As part of this approach, you may be required to submit to Harel current medical documents or to schedule an examination to assess your current functional and medical condition, in the framework of the times noted in the request.
Failure to provide the requested documents timeously and/or non-cooperation regarding an examination by an appropriate professional determined by Harel in a timely manner may result in termination of payment of insurance benefits or delay in payment thereof.
Harel reserves the right to conduct a re-examination of your eligibility if necessary, even in cases where the insured's eligibility is confirmed for a predetermined period and during the period information is received by Harel which differs from that provided by the insured and/or which was known to Harel and indicates that the insured may have ceased to be eligible for insurance benefits.
